operator_assessment.operator_summary: This export follows a narrowly scoped home_representation maintenance pass: 13 of 16 skewed sibling home-representation pools across the canonical 2026-2027 season were repaired to material_spread 0 using canonical count-preserving coupled home+away sibling swaps. Deterministic verification is hard-valid (ok:true, zero violations), export-format consistency checks all match the plan, and no new hosting, placement, manual-placement or participation_target findings were introduced (participation_target finding count unchanged at 209; temporal_spacing improved by one, from 81 to 80). The remaining REVIEW_REQUIRED status reflects pre-existing, unrelated findings that predate this pass and were deliberately left untouched per explicit maintenance scope.

key_tradeoffs.title: 4 home_representation findings left unresolved
key_tradeoffs.summary: Frisk Asker U10, Frisk Asker U9, Frisk Asker JU12 and Jar U10 have no repair-options or bounded-search candidate that is consequence_acceptable: every enumerated sibling swap for these pools worsens a sibling's participation shortfall, so the repair was deliberately withheld rather than trading participation fairness for home-representation fairness.

key_tradeoffs.title: Tønsberg U12 required a 6-tournament coupled plan
key_tradeoffs.summary: The only option reaching material_spread 0 for Tønsberg U12 (spread 4->0) touches 6 tournaments via 3 coupled home+away sibling-swap pairs; smaller 2-tournament options only reduced spread to 3. The repository classified the 6-tournament option hard-valid, consequence_acceptable and non-dominated.

remaining_actions.title: Frisk Asker U10/U9/JU12 and Jar U10 home representation stays skewed
remaining_actions.summary: No safe canonical repair exists today without worsening a sibling's participation target; revisit if participation targets are relaxed or a new repair dimension becomes available.

remaining_actions.title: Pre-existing unrelated findings untouched
remaining_actions.summary: hosting_proportional_balance (5), participation_target (209), temporal_spacing (80), tournament_placement_obligation (12), tournament_roster_shape (6) and manual_placement_opt_in (2) findings remain exactly as before this pass and were out of scope.

limitations: This audit is scoped to verifying the home_representation maintenance pass introduced no regressions; it does not re-review the full pre-existing REVIEW_REQUIRED backlog (hosting/participation/placement), which was out of scope for this task and unaffected by it.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Participation target findings unchanged (209, same as before this pass); the maintenance pass did not alter any team's tournament count.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: This is exactly what was repaired: 13 of 16 skewed multi-team-club home-representation pools were rebalanced to material_spread 0 via canonical count-preserving coupled sibling swaps; 4 pools (Frisk Asker U10, U9, JU12 and Jar U10) remain skewed because every enumerated repair/search candidate would worsen a sibling's participation shortfall (consequence_acceptable: false) and was correctly withheld.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: Not touched by this pass; only participant rosters at existing tournament placements were swapped, dates/times/arenas unchanged.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: Unaffected; no placement/date/arena changes were made, only same-tournament participant substitutions.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar vertsklubben i samme turnering?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verification (ok:true, zero violations) confirms host-club participation is intact after the swaps; host responsibility was explicitly required unchanged by every applied option's evidence.host_responsibility_unchanged flag.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verification passes with zero violations across the full season after all applies, so this hard rule holds.

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: Not affected by sibling swaps (they exchange which sibling participates, not how many same-club teams share a tournament); deterministic verification is clean.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: export_consistency_summary reports matches_plan: true with zero mismatches for csv_games, csv_overview, csv_team_counts, ical and excel.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: No new material problems introduced by this pass. Pre-existing, unrelated REVIEW_REQUIRED reasons (hosting_balance_imbalances, participation_shortfalls, participation_target_deviation, tournament_placement_shortfall, external_calendar_conflicts, movable_host_confirmation_required) are untouched and out of this maintenance pass's explicit scope.
